persons.name: Nīlakaṇṭha
persons.evidence: chrinīlakaṃṭhaḥ śrutiśāstraniṣṭhaḥ || vidvac chivaprītikaraṃ vyadhāt tat saṃjñāvivekaṃ

date.as_written: śākenetrābdhyaṃvubhṛtsammiter 1742 ʼke kuṃbhar kṣasthe bhūjavāre sitārddhe || māghe ... viṣṇutithyāṃ

notes: The scribe's name is given as Lālaratnākara in the verse ('lālaratnākareṇa'), catalogued as Ratnākaralāla. The chronogram contains netra (2), abdhi (4), aṃvubhṛt (7), giving 1742, accompanied by the numerical figure 1742. 'Viṣṇutithi' signifies the 11th lunar day (ekādaśī), and 'bhūjavāra' is Tuesday (Bhaumavāra).
